interpretation_limits: RTC-S1 has no consolidated provider PASS/FAIL disposition; this result cannot promote the pair beyond diagnostic status.
DSWx-HLS is optical product context derived from HLS, not independent field truth or SAR validation.
Acquisition proximity and spatial association do not establish causation; the retained pair spans about 24 days.
No inferential statistic is reported because neighboring pixels are spatially dependent and no evaluation design was specified.
Optical common-area fractions summarize categorical product output; they do not estimate subpixel water area.
The retained DSWx cells were selected for AOI display, so incomplete edge coverage is reported rather than imputed.

method.association_metric: Pearson correlation of per-cell optical water-fraction change with signed RTC-S1 gamma-zero log-ratio; descriptive only.
method.common_optical_support: Only DSWx cells whose before and after WTR codes are both in the retained valid class set [0, 1, 2] contribute to either date's fractions.
method.coverage_fraction_denominator: Full RTC-S1 cell area; DSWx samples are the retained AOI display cells, so edge coverage may be incomplete.
method.sar_validity: The retained common-clear and finite-value masks are both required.
method.sensitivity: Descriptive summaries repeated at multiple minimum common-valid optical area coverage thresholds.
method.spatial_join: Transform native cell corner rings to the RTC-S1 projected CRS and intersect polygons; use exact overlap area to calculate DSWx class fractions per SAR cell.

references.title: OPERA Dynamic Surface Water Extent from Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 product (Version 1)

scope: Exact area-weighted spatial overlay of NASA OPERA DSWx-HLS WTR classes onto NASA OPERA RTC-S1 30 m cells; not a flood boundary, causal test, or validated finding.

sources.optical_product: NASA OPERA L3 DSWx-HLS WTR classification; Sentinel-2 HLS-derived optical context

sar_provider_qa.basis: Per-product HDF5 QA metadata are retained for both acquisitions. The sidecars do not provide a consolidated PASS/FAIL disposition.
sar_provider_qa.scientific_gate: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; QA metadata do not establish temporal registration or validate change interpretation
